title: Rustbucket Visual Novel
author: jgesq
selftext:
**Rustbucket** is a short noir visual novel about inheritance: what the people we lose leave behind, who it really belongs to, and what it costs to open it.  
**Four endings**, shaped by how you read the city and what you choose to show.  
**Two ways in.** Crack the building like a lock, or read it like a pattern.  
**Hidden threads.** A few words in the text can be pulled. Follow them and Jezebel has more to say.  
**Around 30 minutes** per playthrough, built to be replayed.  
**Plays in your browser.** No download needed.

**AI disclosure:** The background art, character portraits and illustrations were generated with AI image tools (OpenArt, primarily Seedream), then selected, edited, composited and processed by hand. The story, writing and design are human-made. Code was written with AI assistance.
